turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander, I can look that up for you. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address used for the order.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
Sorry, I can’t look up or share order details by name alone. Please provide both the order number and the email address used for the order.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share any order details without verifying the order number and the email address used for it. If you’d like me to check, please provide both.
